citations.assessment: Rav Acha of Difti addresses Ravina. The segment does not state that Rava was present.
The academy initially favors Acha. Tavyomi is the signature of Mar bar Rav Ashi, who ultimately takes the post.
Rav Ashi says favor does not return quickly; Acha of Difti strengthens it to never. The narrator rejects the stronger statement as Acha’s personal reaction.
These three eat together and none stands out as the senior authority for leading the blessing.
Rav Acha of Difti questions Ravina about the scope of Rava’s question. The Hebrew’s preceding bare names are retained.
